clarity.justification: The central comparison is precisely aligned with the hypothesis: the plan measures "acceptance rate in pre-retrieval MINUS acceptance in the no-pre-retrieval control" while holding the misinformation fixed and adding an "equal-length filler" control, plus no-misinformation and irrelevant-retrieval conditions. It is strongly falsifiable through directional, numeric criteria such as "HIGHER by >=8pp with CI excluding 0," with a null CI or protective effect explicitly refuting the transfer, and later hypotheses likewise have AUROC, recovery, intervention, and specificity thresholds. A minor clarity gap remains because Experiment 4 first specifies activations "at the re-query position" but later calls the signal "measured at the retrieval act," and the sign of the prediction-error regression is slightly ambiguous because retrieval effort is operationalized using "confidence/margin" while a positive slope is expected for effortful, low-confidence retrieval.

feasibility.justification: The hardest step is constructing and causally manipulating the "destabilization direction residualized on context-following"; residual-stream collection, mean-difference directions, linear residualization, activation patching, and directional ablation are supported by standard PyTorch and interpretability tooling, although the proposed "generic context-following/misinformation-attention probe" needs a more exact construction. The core named artifacts—"Llama-3-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, Gemma-2-9B," PopQA, T-REx/LAMA, and EntityQuestions—exist and support activation-level experimentation, while the exact cited "uncertainty-head masking method" is insufficiently specified but is only a comparison baseline rather than a core dependency. Resources are unusually concrete, including "2,500 facts," "1,000 held-out" trials, "600 items," three models, seeds "{0,1,2}," and intervention doses "{0,0.5,1,2,4}." The refuting branch is runnable because the design includes matched no-pre-retrieval, no-misinformation, random-direction, reverse-injection, unrelated-content, fresh-session, and true-correction controls, so null, protective, nonspecific, or noncausal outcomes can all emerge.
